source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.2「気象の影響」(1)2)e.海陸風

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 沿岸部の局地風は昼夜の熱的条件に応じて海風・陸風が入れ替わる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 沿岸の局地風は昼夜で方向が変わらない。
evidence.reasoning_path: coastal heating cycle -> pressure difference -> wind reversal -> time-of-day route risk

collision.note: LOW。既存のcold-front/一般風問題とは異なるlocal wind time-of-day variation。

independent_review.rationale: 6.2 supports daytime sea breeze toward warmer land and nighttime land breeze toward sea; no released item tests this reversal.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions. The 23 accepted candidates retain distinct propositions and commercial practice value; the two collision candidates must not receive acceptance packets or Permanent IDs.
